findings.finding: Unexplained respiratory symptoms had no actionable oxaliplatin rule.
findings.correction: Added oxaliplatin-only hold until interstitial disease/pulmonary fibrosis excluded; no inferred permanent discontinuation.

findings.finding: Breastfeeding was folded into a generic pregnancy/lactation review, despite explicit source exclusion.
findings.correction: Added breastfeeding contraindication; retained original pregnancy rule ID and individualized pregnancy review.

findings.finding: Renal review quoted only the no-reduction/caution table and ignored the contradictory impaired-renal-function exclusion; severe_renal_impairment alone was not linked.
findings.correction: Explicit source-conflict review now triggered by renal impairment, severe renal impairment or haemodialysis, without an invented percentage or clearance.

findings.finding: Exactly 1.5 × ULN bilirubin was assigned unilaterally to the lower printed band.
findings.correction: Added boundary review: printed ≤1.5 and 1.5–3 overlap. Starting-dose table restricted to initial treatment; existing later-treatment review retained.

findings.finding: Highest diarrhoea grade input did not feed the source non-haematological grade ≥3 dose-reduction review.
findings.correction: Prior grade3/4 diarrhoea now activates the 15–20% consultant choice after recovery; no midpoint or fixed dose is calculated.

findings.finding: Dose-level reductions were interpreted from standard level 0, ignoring actual prior component dose; 00449 had no current-level inputs.
findings.correction: Mapped every level change to current component level; added 00449 dose-history inputs. Missing history produces current-level-required output; cumulative level −3 produces discontinue.

findings.finding: Nadir/toxicity rules could select a restart dose with unknown delay duration; 00449 GI highest grades triggered without current recovery and haematological reduction checked only one count.
findings.correction: Restart dose selection requires both counts where relevant, recovery grade and source-specific four-week (00446) or two-week (00449) window. Added missing-context and late-recovery review.

findings.finding: Source initial fluorouracil hepatic percentages could reset subsequent treatment to a fraction of the original dose, regardless of prior reductions.
findings.correction: Restricted numeric initial hepatic fractions to baseline assessment. Subsequent or unknown phase requires consultant review of actual prior dose and current toxicity.

findings.finding: Only uncontrolled/symptomatic hypertension hold existed; grade4 or persisting grade3 permanent stop was absent.
findings.correction: Added explicit clinically assessed grade4/persisting-grade3 bevacizumab discontinuation, tested with concurrent ordinary hypertension hold.

findings.finding: Arterial-event rule did not cover all source grade4 thromboembolic events, including life-threatening venous events.
findings.correction: Added separate grade4 thromboembolism bevacizumab stop, without applying it to all lower-grade venous events.

findings.finding: Recovered counts after two weeks had no explicit source-window review. Febrile-neutropenia dose reduction could still print a numeric dose after late recovery.
findings.correction: Added late-count-recovery review; applied two-week recovery gate and missing-recovery review to the febrile-neutropenia restart branch.

findings.finding: Unknown or late GI recovery suppressed numeric restart rules but did not explicitly explain the missing/late recovery decision.
findings.correction: Added explicit diarrhoea and stomatitis recovery-context reviews. Retained the separate requirement for full resolution of irinotecan-related diarrhoea.

retained_source_controls: FOLFOX4 renal boundary exactly CrCl30 and fluorouracil bilirubin85 µmol/L/AST180 U/L gaps remain explicit review; absolute values are not silently treated as ULN multiples.

Irinotecan monotherapy severe combined nadir criterion uses ANC<0.5 AND platelets<25; isolated low counts still independently withhold treatment. Reduction range is 15–20%, not an automatic 17.5% or borrowed FOLFIRI dose level.

00449 and 00448 ANC table permits restart within two weeks but says stop if still low after four weeks; source interval conflict is preserved, not rewritten to an invented universal two-week or four-week restart window.

Bevacizumab 24h urine protein ≤2 allows treatment on that criterion; >2 through4 holds; >4 stops. Dipstick2+/3+ requests 24h collection before next dose, whereas4+ holds. No bevacizumab dose reduction is invented.

00448 baseline counts ANC ≥2/platelets ≥100 differ from subsequent-cycle ANC ≥1.5/platelets ≥75. Rash occurrence recovery remains100%/80%/60% original dose after one/two held doses; fourth occurrence or failed recovery stops.
5-FU folinic-acid linkage and different infusion schedules remain: FOLFOX4 has two 22 h infusions; modified FOLFOX6/FOLFIRI use a 46 h infusion.

DPD complete deficiency excludes fluoropyrimidine treatment; partial deficiency needs individualized starting dose/titration. UGT1A1*28 homozygosity prompts irinotecan review where stated, without invented numeric reductions.
